nodes.name: checkout-service
nodes.summary: The checkout request path (CheckoutHandler.process): acquires a pool connection, charges via the payment gateway, then enqueues fulfillment.

nodes.name: payment-gateway
nodes.summary: PaymentClient.charge — the degrading dependency where the latency spike originates (one retry + backoff every GATEWAY_SLOW_EVERY-th charge).

nodes.name: fulfillment
nodes.summary: FulfillmentQueue.enqueue — the healthy leaf; sub-millisecond append with no latency dynamics under demo-length runs.

nodes.name: connection-pool
nodes.summary: ConnectionPool (DB_POOL_SIZE=10) — held across PaymentClient.charge's retry loop by CheckoutHandler.process (the code-only Incident A). No saturation metric is emitted for it today.
